packageRules.description: Euro Office documentserver base image tracks upstream's own floating :latest tag directly (see Dockerfile) -- no version to pin, no PR to merge. The weekly cron rebuild in build.yml keeps it current instead. Disabled here so Renovate does not propose pinning it to a digest, which would reintroduce the same PR-per-update friction one level down.
The compose file is for people to copy, so it follows the app's own latest tag instead of a digest that goes stale every build
